description: This file is an Android Activity that demonstrates how to play audio using the MediaPlayer API. It handles playing local audio files specified via a file path or resource audio stored in res/raw, with UI feedback via a TextView and Toast messages.

classes.name: MediaPlayerDemo_Audio
classes.description: An Android Activity class that demonstrates media playback functionality, including handling different sources of audio.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and starts audio playback based on intent extras.

methods.name: playAudio
methods.description: Handles setting up and starting media playback from various sources, either local file path or resource.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with MediaPlayer when the activity is destroyed.
